method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Replacement uses bounded side-to-side rocking with mild basket/rope sway rather than sustained upward travel.
Entire balloon envelope and basket stay inside the frame across all overview and dense samples, resolving the previous cropped-envelope failure.
Orange, yellow, green, blue and purple panels remain ordered and stable; brown basket and suspension ropes remain connected and coherent.
Visible restrained swaying is appropriate to a balloon, with no face, character features, unexpected objects or obvious morphing.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
